core_reason: Adding cI shifts eigenvalues without changing eigenvectors, and the shifted discrete Doob kernel decomposes as identity plus a scaled generator-style Doob transform.

calculations.name: right_eigen_shift
calculations.calculation: sum_j (K_ij + c delta_ij) h_j = sum_j K_ij h_j + c h_i = (lambda + c) h_i

calculations.name: left_eigen_shift
calculations.calculation: sum_i q_i (K_ij + c delta_ij) = sum_i q_i K_ij + c q_j = (lambda + c) q_j

calculations.name: nonnegativity
calculations.calculation: Off-diagonal entries are unchanged; diagonal entries become K_ii+c.
